title: Planet Tweaks V2.5.7 ULTRA — App Debloater Suite, Mouse Pointer Studio, Overhauled Auth Modal & Input Polish
releaseNotes: Live App Debloater Suite: Real-time scan and clean removal of built-in Microsoft bloatware with dedicated Removed Apps view. Mouse Pointer & Link Hand Studio: Moved to Input & Crosshair with custom .cur/.ani loading and instant live OS broadcast. Redesigned Auth & Profile Modal: Featuring official Google vector branding, active profile card stack, and permanent GamerTag persistence. Input & UI Polish: Fixed emoji rendering boxes with Segoe UI Emoji fallbacks, unified Mouse Acceleration Thresholds 1 & 2, expanded GeForce NOW & Cloud Gaming tweaks, and improved Inno Setup updater visibility.
